D: An Ohio couple's trip to New York becomes a night of non-stop disasters.
P: Serve dessert when George finally gets to eat something.
S: rationed between two of them all night
Shortbread (butter, icing sugar, flour) pressed into a tin, scored into fingers, baked at 160C for 25 minutes, wrapped in a napkin.
Dry-roasted peanuts tossed with fine salt and a little brown sugar, warmed in the oven for 5 minutes, into small paper packets.
the only food they find all night
Franks simmered with onion until plump, in steamed buns with mustard and sauerkraut, wrapped in paper.
M: the hotel they're trying to reach
Diced apple, celery and grapes with toasted walnuts in a dressing of mayo, lemon and a little crème fraîche, on butter lettuce.
breakfast in the room at last
Rib eye seared and rested, two fried eggs, crisp hash browns (grated potato squeezed dry, fried in butter) and buttered toast.
W: Baked New York cheesecake, water bath at 150C for 70 minutes, chilled overnight, strawberries on top.

edition.cue: Serve dessert when George finally gets to eat something.

s.note: Buttery shortbread fingers baked golden and wrapped in a napkin.
s.how: Rub 100g butter into 150g plain flour and 50g icing sugar. Press into a lined 15cm square tin, score into 8 fingers and bake at 160C for 25 minutes. Cool for 15 minutes, cut along the score lines and wrap in napkins.

s.note: Warm dry-roasted peanuts tossed with salt and brown sugar.
s.how: Toss 160g dry-roasted peanuts with 1/4 tsp fine salt and 2 tsp brown sugar. Spread on a tray and warm at 160C for 5 minutes. Divide between 4 small paper packets.

m.note: Seared rib eye, fried eggs, crisp hash browns and buttered toast.
m.how: Grate 600g potatoes and squeeze dry in a tea towel. Season with 1/2 tsp salt, shape into 4 hash browns and fry in 40g butter over medium heat for 6 minutes a side. Sear 4 rib eye steaks, 200g each, in a very hot pan with 1 tbsp oil for about 3 minutes a side to 54C, then rest for 8 minutes. Fry 8 eggs in 20g butter for 3 minutes. Toast 4 sourdough slices and spread with 20g butter. Serve one steak, two eggs, one hash brown and one toast per person.

w.note: Baked New York cheesecake chilled overnight and topped with strawberries.
w.how: Crush 120g digestive biscuits and mix with 50g melted butter. Press into a lined 18cm springform tin. Beat 400g cream cheese with 100g caster sugar, then mix in 100g sour cream, 2 eggs and 1 tsp vanilla. Pour over the base. Wrap the tin in two layers of foil and stand in a roasting dish with hot water halfway up its sides. Bake at 150C for 70 minutes until the centre gently wobbles. Cool for 1 hour, refrigerate overnight and top with 200g sliced strawberries. Cut four generous portions, with leftovers.

d.note: Gin and dry vermouth stirred cold with an olive garnish.
d.how: For each of 4 drinks stir 60ml gin and 10ml dry vermouth over ice for 30 seconds. Strain into a frozen martini glass and garnish with 1 green olive.
